jobs.title: Engagement Expert London, UK, GB
jobs.description: Zencity - Start your career. Check out our open positions here. Skip to content Platform Listen Ask Communicate Workflows Resident Communications Annual Planning & Budgeting Performance Management Who We Serve Zencity for Cities Zencity for Counties Zencity for Public Safety Zencity for Communication Teams Customers Resources Articles Case Studies Guides and Reports Webinars About Us Our Story Our Team Careers FAQs Contact Us Discover Zencity Log In Book a Demo Learn More Careers Engagement Expert Engagement Expert London, UK, GB Customer Success Full-time Intermediate About The Position About Zencity Zencity is a mission-driven company transforming the work of government through community voices. Our community input and insights platform leverages advanced NLP and machine learning to help local government organizations make data-driven decisions. We work with 400+ cities and counties across the UK, US and Canada, from Westminster to MHCLG and Leeds. If you are passionate about leveraging data and technology to solve real-world challenges and improve life in communities, your place is with us. Why This Role Matters The Engagement Expert is the post-sale operational engine of the Zencity customer relationship. From the moment a deal closes, you own the journey — driving implementations to a successful go-live, launching recurring projects, and ensuring the platform delivers measurable value against each client's goals. You are the operational heartbeat of our customer relationships, ensuring that every city, county, and agency we serve gets up and running fast and keeps getting value long after. What You Will Do Own implementation end-to-end: Manage the full implementation lifecycle from Closed Won through configured, trained, and signed-off go-live — hitting the 60-day clock per the Implementation Playbook. Configure and personalize the platform: Set up and tailor Zencity's product suite across Listen, Ask, and Communicate to meet each client's specific needs and use cases. Contribute to pre-sales solution design: Partner with Account Executives on Solution Design Documents, ensuring what's sold can be successfully delivered. Train and enable client users: Deliver training and best-practices guidance that empowers client teams to get the most out of Zencity independently. Drive recurring project delivery: Own the creation, QA, and client sign-off of DIY surveys and content pages on an ongoing basis after go-live. Track adoption and health: Monitor feature adoption, survey design quality, and account health signals — surfacing CSQLs and risk flags to the Account Manager early. Requirements What We Are Looking For Required 5+ years in a customer-facing implementation, onboarding, or delivery role in a B2B SaaS environment. Strong project management skills with a track record of managing multiple concurrent implementations against defined timelines and milestones. Product fluency: Ability to configure, personalize, and train clients on a technical platform across multiple modules. Local government and/or public safety domain knowledge: You understand how government organizations operate and can speak credibly to their workflows and priorities. Data curiosity and analytical skills: Comfortable working with data, identifying patterns, and helping clients connect platform outputs to real decisions. Client-facing presence: Confident delivering training, leading working sessions, and managing stakeholder expectations across levels. Preferred Experience working with NLP, ML-powered products, or data analytics platforms. Familiarity with community engagement, communications, or public safety workflows in a government context. Experience with project management tools (Monday.com or similar) and CS platforms (Planhat, Gainsight, or similar). Experience utilizing AI tools to improve delivery. What Success Looks Like 90%+ gross retention across your portfolio. Consistent achievement of quarterly adoption and engagement KPIs. Strong NPS/CSAT scores from executive stakeholders. Expansion pipeline generated in partnership with Account Management. Customers who actively advocate for Zencity in their networks. Boundary Lines This role is part of a specialized, collaborative delivery model. To set clear expectations: Commercial relationship ownership sits with Account Management . Custom analyses and premium methodology engagements are delivered by Expert Services . Tier 1 and Tier 2 platform support is handled by Operations (Support) . Survey distribution operations and technical setup are owned by Operations (Survey Ops and Technical Implementation) . This role will require 25% travel. This role is Hybrid based out of London, UK offices. Salary Range: Base pay 45 to 55k GBP Apply for this position Apply Now Ready to get started? Reach out to our team to schedule a demo. jobs.description: Zencity - Start your career. Check out our open positions here. Zencity is re-inventing the way governments hear from, understand, and engage with their residents. Our community input & insights platform and community survey solution use advanced NLP and ML algorithms to help government organizations make data-driven decisions. With a global team of urban enthusiasts and data experts, we partner with over 300 cities worldwide-from Los Angeles to New York to Tel Aviv-helping them create more responsive and informed policies. If you’re passionate about leveraging data and technology to solve real-world challenges and improve life in cities and counties, we’d love to have you on board! What is the Role? As a Product Manager at Zencity, you will lead the product work and execution, be responsible for the entire product lifecycle, from concept to production. You will establish a shared vision for your product across the company at large, while collaborating closely with cross-functional team members from (e.g. design, R&D, product marketing) and receive input from customers, leadership and various departments like customer success, sales and professional services, in order to lead the product from concept to launch. You will own the roadmap-building process for these products, as well as lead product initiatives that will have a great impact on the future direction of the company. Responsibilities Fully own the product management lifecycle for our survey product in line to the company’s strategic vision: the roadmap, KPIs, research, user experience, and finally collaborate with R&D on execution and monitor adoption. Perform research and discovery to understand and prioritize our customers' pain points, and analyze user feedback, product analytics, and market research and competition, to turn user needs into detailed product requirements and user workflows Build the business case for new product development, involve various stakeholders to get buy-in and communicate the vision to the wider teams. Product Requirements; translate the new product strategy into detailed requirements and prototypes. Launch new features (and sometimes products) in collaboration with the sales and marketing teams, helping develop the go-to-market plans. Work with a variety of stakeholders across engineering, customer success, sales, professional services, marketing and operations. Requirements 3-4 years of experience, including proven experience in a building successful SaaS products Data driven with experience managing complex processes with multiple stakeholders Strong understanding of all elements of the entire product management process and product lifecycle Skilled in product discovery in its multiple forms, and in defining user workflows and sketching wireframes. A good balance of technical savviness and business acumen with an ability to dive into the details as well as broad strategic thinking Proven experience with data-rich applications and AI-driven features Experience working with US-based customers and teams Excellent communication skills in English Experience working with local governments - an advantage Passionate about impacting the day-to-day lives of millions of city dwellers worldwide. This role is Hybrid and based at our Brooklyn, NY office. Salary Range: $150k-$180k Apply for this position Apply Now Ready to get started? Reach out to our team to schedule a demo. jobs.description: Zencity Accessibility Statement Skip to content Platform Listen Ask Communicate Workflows Resident Communications Annual Planning & Budgeting Performance Management Who We Serve Zencity for Cities Zencity for Counties Zencity for Public Safety Zencity for Communication Teams Customers Resources Articles Case Studies Guides and Reports Webinars About Us Our Story Our Team Careers FAQs Contact Us Discover Zencity Log In Book a Demo Learn More Accessibility Statement Zencity is a digital engagement platform that is used by local governments and placemakers (‘engagement partners’) to engage with the public in a transparent way. Each engagement partner manages and customises their own web-based experience, which contains custom content that is uploaded by the organization(s) facilitating the engagement. Members of the public can learn and feedback about changes in their neighbourhoods or the services you use. Zencity aims to have as many members of the public as possible access its platform. This accessibility statement is drafted for the resident-facing aspects Zencity, which combine a suite of capabilities: Web pages for community engagement and communication Web-hosted surveys for gathering community feedback and consultation Emails for delivering community news and providing authenticated access to residents Digital live engagement tools for capturing feedback in a face-to-face setting Throughout this document, we will refer to the above capabilities as the ‘web platform’. Our goal is to be able to support the widest array of browsers and assistive technologies as possible. We have therefore invested efforts to support popular systems with high market share, including Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Opera and Safari VoiceOver on a MAC. We have also addressed JAWS and NVDA assistive technologies for Windows and MAC. For example, that means you should be able to: change colours, contrast levels and fonts zoom in up to 300% without the text spilling off the screen navigate most of the website using just a keyboard navigate most of the website using speech recognition software listen to most of the website using a screen reader (including the most recent versions of JAWS, NVDA and VoiceOver) In order to make the platform more accessible, we incorporate a number of guidelines and restrictions on the ways in which content can be customized which help engagement partners to maintain the highest standards of accessibility, in accordance with WCAG 2.2AA. We’ve also made the web platform text as simple as possible to understand by actively working with engagement partners to highlight language which may be a little difficult to understand. Some Zencity websites and webpages incorporate EqualWeb’s automatic accessibility tool in order to make this website more accessible. You will find this on the screen by looking for the accessibility icon: AbilityNet and Knowbility have advice on making your device easier to use if you have a disability. How accessible this web platform is We know some features of the Zencity web platform are not yet fully accessible. For engagement partners who wish to make their content fully accessible, we guide them to avoid using certain features or to make adjustments to make them accessible. It is the responsibility of our engagement partners to design and build their own content which is added to their Zencity web platform. A list of the features which may not be accessible, depending on how our engagement partner has created their web platform: Most older PDF documents are not fully accessible to screen reader software. We offer tools to assist our engagement partners in making PDF documents more accessible that they may opt into using. Embedded videos may not contain captions. We offer guidance to our engagement partners on how to add captions into their videos. Some images may not contain alternative text descriptions. It is our engagement partner’s responsibility to ensure they are providing alternative text descriptions for their images. The web platform editor provides guidance and validation for the engagement partner. Interactive images (with hover / click functionality) are not always fully accessible to screen reader software and should only be used where there is an alternative navigation option. Colour contrast may not be optimised to be fully compliant. The web platform editor provides guidance and validation for the engagement partner. Headings may not reflect page hierarchy. It is our engagement partner’s responsibility to ensure they are using the correct headings to reflect the hierarchy of content on the page. You may not be able to skip to content on all pages. Rating and sentiment scale questions (for example, 1–5 scales or star or smiley ratings) may not be accessible if the meaning of the scale is not clearly described in text. For example, a question asking respondents to rate something from 1 to 5 must explain what 1 represents and what 5 represents (e.g. “1 = strongly disagree and 5 = strongly agree”). It is the responsibility of the engagement partner to ensure that rating scales include clear textual descriptions of the scale values, either within the question itself or in introductory text immediately before the question. If scale values are not clearly defined in text, this may not meet WCAG 2.2 AA success criteria relating to instructions and form labelling. Alternatively, they should include a text box before the question with a sentence explaining that the following question(s) use a rating scale of 1 to 5 ‘where 1 is X and 5 is X’ or similar. This will ensure that WCAG 2.2AA accessibility requirements are met. Zencity functionality: Collaborative maps (and associated pin-drop or polygon-drawing functionality) are not fully accessible. jobs.description: Zencity - Code of Conduct Skip to content Platform Listen Ask Communicate Workflows Resident Communications Annual Planning & Budgeting Performance Management Who We Serve Zencity for Cities Zencity for Counties Zencity for Public Safety Zencity for Communication Teams Customers Resources Articles Case Studies Guides and Reports Webinars About Us Our Story Our Team Careers FAQs Contact Us Discover Zencity Log In Book a Demo Learn More Zencity Code of Conduct Values: Zencity’s mission is to vastly improve and augment how local governments obtain public input and use it to make effective decisions. Our services are dedicated to helping local leaders receive equitable, inclusive, and continuous resident feedback. In doing so, we strengthen civic trust and bridge the gap between communities and their governments to meaningfully improve daily life in communities around the globe. We achieve this by lowering the barriers for people to be heard by government leaders and making it seamless for public servants to understand and incorporate input from their community in every decision they make. Zencity helps local government leaders learn from aggregated data, reflecting the varied and diverse voices in their entire community. Our goal is to surface and highlight the issues, priorities, and concerns raised and discussed by the community, while adhering to the highest standards of protecting the values we are promoting. This includes protecting the privacy of individuals, the accountability of government to those they serve, and openness and transparency . Zencity’s platform is built to support these principles by design. This Code of Conduct exists to emphasize our and our partners’ commitment to these principles , and align expectations on the use and outcome of our suite of services among our team, customers, and the communities that they serve. Permissible Use: Zencity’s platform must be used in accordance with all applicable federal, state, and local laws. Zencity’s platform may not be used for a) any discriminatory or unlawful purpose; b) conducting surveillance or gathering intelligence, including but not limited to investigating, tracking, or profiling individuals; c) any non-governmental purpose, including electioneering; d) any law enforcement effort action to interdict individuals’ or groups’ exercise of free speech, free assembly, and protest. Zencity does not enable the tracking of individuals online; the identification of links between people; the creation of profiles; the tracking of an individual’s physical location; the creation of dissemination of any authentic or inauthentic social media accounts, content, or communications; or the collection or storage of information about an individual’s social media account data. Zencity employees, partners and clients are encouraged to monitor, identify, and report any potential violations of this code of conduct. Any violations are grounds for termination of user access or services. If you suspect a violation is taking place, we invite you to reach out to us at codeofconduct@zencity.io .
